mavzu: Unit 12 - Lesson 1: How did you get here?

savollar.savol: "I got to the zoo by ___" gapni to'ldiring.
Qaysi so'z transport vositasi?
"I got to ___" gapda qaysi joy keladi?
"by" keying keyingi so'z nima bo'ladi?
Piyoda ketish uchun qaysi so'z ishlatiladi?
Qaysi so'z joy emas?
Transport vositalarining to'g'ri ro'yxatini tanlang.
Joylarning to'g'ri ro'yxatini tanlang.
"I got to the park by ___" gapni to'ldiring.
Qaysi so'z minivan bilan bog'liq?
Do'stim: "I got to the museum by taxi" dedi. U qaysi joyga ketdi?
"I got to the flower shop" gapida keying so'z qaysi?
To'g'ri gapni tanlang.
variantlar: I got the zoo by bus
I got to zoo by bus
I got to the zoo bus
I got to the zoo by bus

savollar.savol: Kasallar davolanadigun joyga ketish kerak. Qaysi joy?
Transport vositalaridan eng sekin qaysi?
Qaysi juftlik to'g'ri: joy - transport?
Kitoblarni sotadigan joyga ketdim. Qaysi joyga ketdim?
Haydovchisiz ishlaydigan transport vositalarini tanlang.
"I got to the school by bike" - bu qanday gap?
"Motor" degan ma'noni har bir so'zga beramiz. Qaysi transport motorli emas?
Matnga ko'ra "I got to" gapda qaysi kelgan so'z kelib chiqish joyni aytadi?
"Maktabga taxi bilan ketdim" - to'g'ri ingliz tiliga tarjimasi?
variantlar: I got the taxi at school
I got to the school by taxi
I got by taxi to school

savollar.savol: Qaysi ikkita transport pedal bilan harakat qiladi?
Gapda nechta joy-transport juftligi bor? "I got to the zoo by taxi, the museum by bus, the park by bike, the flower shop by car"
Transport vositalarini tezlikka ko'ra tez-sekin tartibda joylashtiring:
Bola "I got there by bus" dedi. "there" so'zi nima anglatadi?
"I got to the book shop" gapda nima haqida hech narsa aytilmadi?
Transport vositalarni "motorli" va "bemortor" qismlarga ajrating. To'g'ri bo'linish qaysi?
variantlar: Motorli: taxi, bus, car, motorbike; Bemortor: bike, foot
Motorli: car, bike, motorbike; Bemortor: taxi, bus, foot
Motorli: bus, minivan, taxi; Bemortor: bike, motorbike, car, foot
Motorli: taxi, car; Bemortor: bus, bike, motorbike, foot

savollar.savol: Ikkita gapni birlashtiring: "I got to the zoo." va "I went by taxi." To'g'ri birlashma qaysi?
variantlar: I got to the zoo by taxi
I went to the zoo by taxi
I got and went to the zoo by taxi
I got to the zoo and I went by taxi

savollar.savol: Matndagi barcha ma'lumotni o'z ichiga olgan va to'g'ri gap qaysi?
variantlar: I got to the zoo by taxi, the museum by bus, the park by bike
I got to the flower shop and market by motorbike
I got to the zoo and museum by taxi
I got the book shop by car and bike
